{{Quote|Well, they just played moopsball for a while. With us as the ball.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>}}
'''Moopsball''' was a sport played with a ball. [[Ferryboat liner]]s included moopsball courts.<ref name="Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Moopsball is a comedic fictional sport invented by science fiction author Gary Cohn in 1976.
